blocks.text: Cellular respiration woh aalmi (universal) amal hai jis se jandar (organisms) glucose jaise pecheeda (complex) carbon wale compounds tor kar qabil-e-istemal tawanai (energy) hasil karte hain: C6H12O6 + 6O2 se 6CO2 + 6H2O + tawanai. Glucose mein atoms ki tarteeb zyada zakheera tawanai rakhti hai, aur CO2 aur H2O ki tarteeb bohat kam, kyunke glucose mein bohat se C-H bonds hain jabke CO2 aur H2O mein koi nahin.

blocks.title: Bahari aur cellular tanaffus (respiration)
blocks.text: Jandar aur us ke mahol (environment) ke darmiyan CO2 aur O2 ka tabadla bahari tanaffus, ya saans lena, hai. Cellular respiration woh amal hai jis se cells ke andar khuraak ke qadam-ba-qadam oxidation se cells ko tawanai dastiyab hoti hai.

Cellular respiration ke bunyadi waqiat tamam cells mein taqreeban ek jaise hain, aur tamam jandaron ke taqreeban tamam cells glucose ko tawanai ka zariya banate hain; isi liye glucose ko respiratory fuel kehte hain. Aap ke cells ke bohat se reactions mendak, chuhe, planaria, khumbi (mushroom) aur mooli ke cells mein bhi hote hain. Is ki do bari qismein hain: anaerobic respiration (fermentation), oxygen ki ghair-maujoodgi mein, aur aerobic respiration, oxygen ki maujoodgi mein. Dono ke pehle qadam mein glucose glycolysis mein pyruvic acid (C3H4O3) ke do molecules mein toot-ta hai; pyruvic acid ke baad ke reactions mukhtalif hain.
Anaerobic respiration ka tareeqa

Anaerobic respiration bohat se microorganisms mein, aala podon ke kuch cells mein aur vertebrates ke muscle cells mein hoti hai. Glucose mukammal oxidise nahin hota, is liye yeh tanaffus nisbatan kam tawanai deta hai: ek glucose molecule sirf do ATPs deta hai, glucose ki tawanai ka taqreeban 2 fisad, jo 14.6 kcal ke barabar hai. Anaerobic respiration glycolysis aur phir NADH se pyruvic acid ke lactic acid ya alcohol aur CO2 mein reduction par mushtamil hai.

items: Alcoholic fermentation: qadeem prokaryotic cells (bacteria) aur yeast jaise kuch eukaryotic cells mein pyruvic acid mazeed toot kar alcohol (C2H5OH) aur CO2 banata hai: 2 C3H4O3 se 2 C2H5OH + 2 CO2.

Lactic acid fermentation: oxygen ki ghair-maujoodgi mein har pyruvic acid lactic acid (C3H6O3) mein badalta hai: 2 C3H4O3 se 2 C3H6O3. Yeh insanon aur doosre janwaron ke muscle cells mein sakht jismani mehnat ke dauran hoti hai, jab oxygen cells tak utni tezi se nahin pohanch pati jitni chahiye; bohat se bacteria bhi ise istemal karte hain.

blocks.alt: Do qataren. Upar: glucose (chhe carbon moti) Glycolysis se guzarta hai, 2 ADP + 2 Pi se 2 ATP aur 2 NAD+ se 2 NADH bante hain, aur 2 pyruvic acid bante hain; Alcoholic Fermentation mein 2 NADH + 2 H+ se 2 NAD+ bante hain aur 2 CO2 nikalti hai, aur 2 ethanol (do carbon wale) bante hain. Neeche: wohi glycolysis, phir Lactic acid Fermentation mein 2 NADH + 2 H+ se 2 NAD+ bante hain, aur 2 lactic acid (teen carbon wale) bante hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.13: Alcoholic fermentation aur lactic acid fermentation (kitab ki Figure 5.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono raston mein glycolysis se sirf 2 ATP milte hain. Fermentation ka asal kaam NADH ko wapas NAD+ banana hai taa ke glycolysis chalta rahe. Yeast mein CO2 nikalti hai aur ethanol banta hai; muscle mein CO2 nahin nikalti aur lactic acid banta hai. Kitab ki chhapi hui figure mein lactic acid ke neeche bhi 'Ethyl alcohol' likha hai; durust naam lactic acid hai, jo yahan likha gaya hai.
Aerobic respiration ka tareeqa

Glucose ka mukammal tootna sirf aerobic respiration mein hota hai: glucose toot kar pyruvic acid banta hai, jo phir mukammal oxidise ho kar CO2 aur pani banta hai, aur us ke C-H bonds ki tamam zakheera tawanai nikal jati hai. Cellular respiration ek musalsal amal hai, magar mutale ke liye ise chaar marhalon mein baanta jata hai: glycolysis, pyruvic acid oxidation, Krebs cycle (citric acid cycle), aur electron transport chain ke saath chemiosmosis. Glycolysis cytosol mein hoti hai aur ise oxygen nahin chahiye; baqi teen marhale mitochondria mein hote hain, jahan oxygen lazmi hai.

blocks.title: Jab oxygen kam thi
blocks.text: Jab zameen par zindagi paida hui to azaad oxygen dastiyab nahin thi, is liye sirf anaerobic respiration mumkin thi. Photosynthesis ke irtiqa (evolution) se hawa mein molecular oxygen aahista jama hui, aur azaad oxygen ki maujoodgi ne aerobic respiration ka irtiqa mumkin banaya.

blocks.alt: Upar do pattiyan Aerobic Respiration (poora raasta) aur Anaerobic Respiration (cytosol wala hissa) dikhati hain. Cytosol mein glucose glycolysis se pyruvic acid banta hai aur 2 ATP milte hain; pyruvic acid alcoholic ya lactic acid fermentation mein ja sakta hai. Mitochondrion mein pyruvic acid acetyl CoA banta hai (CO2 nikalti hai), jo Krebs cycle mein jata hai (do dafa CO2, 2 ATP); phir electron transport chain O2 leti hai, H2O chhorti hai aur 32 ATP banati hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oxygen na ho to raasta pyruvic acid par ruk kar fermentation ki taraf mur jata hai (anaerobic). Oxygen ho to pyruvic acid mitochondrion mein ja kar poori tarah CO2 aur H2O ban jata hai (aerobic). ATP ka hisaab: glycolysis 2, Krebs cycle 2, electron transport chain 32; sab se zyada ATP aakhri marhale se aata hai.
Marhala 1: glycolysis

Glycolysis glucose ka pyruvic acid ke do molecules mein tootna hai. Yeh anaerobic aur aerobic dono respiration mein hoti hai, qadmon ke silsile mein jin mein har ek cytosol mein hal-shuda ek makhsoos enzyme catalyse karta hai; ATP aur coenzyme NAD+ bhi lazmi hain. Is ke do hisse hain, tayyari ka marhala aur oxidative marhala.
Tayyari ka marhala (preparatory phase)
Yeh marhala tawanai kharch karta aur glucose torta hai.

items: ATP se ek phosphate group glucose ko muntaqil hota hai, jo glucose 6-phosphate banta hai.
Glucose 6-phosphate apne isomer fructose 6-phosphate mein badalta hai.
Ek aur ATP fructose 6-phosphate ko doosra phosphate group deta hai, jo fructose 1,6-biphosphate banta hai.

Fructose 1,6-biphosphate bohat reactive hai aur do teen-carbon darmiyani maddon, glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (G3P) aur dihydroxyacetone phosphate (DAP), mein toot-ta hai. Yeh ek doosre mein badalte hain, jis se G3P ke do molecules milte hain.

blocks.text: Oxidative marhala
Yeh marhala G3P se hydrogen nikalta hai aur nikli tawanai ATP ke taur par pack karta hai; har qadam do baar hota hai, har G3P ke liye ek baar.

items: Har G3P apni tezabi shakal mein oxidise hota hai: do hydrogen atoms (do high-energy electrons ke saath) nikal kar NAD+ ko muntaqil hote hain, aur ek inorganic phosphate shamil hota hai, jis se 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid (1,3-BPGA) banta hai.
1,3-BPGA se ek phosphate group ADP ko muntaqil hota hai, jis se 3-phosphoglyceric acid (3-PGA) aur ATP ka ek molecule banta hai.
3-PGA 2-phosphoglyceric acid (2-PGA) mein badalta hai.
2-PGA se pani nikal kar (dehydrate ho kar) phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP) banta hai.
PEP apna high-energy phosphate de kar doosre ADP ko ATP banata hai, aur khud pyruvic acid ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Nau number wale qadam, carbon-moti zanjeeron ke saath. Preparatory phase: glucose (1) se glucose 6-phosphate (qadam 1, ATP se ADP), phir fructose 6-phosphate (2), phir fructose 1,6-biphosphate (3, ATP se ADP), jo (4) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate aur dihydroxyacetone phosphate mein toot-ta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.15: Glycolysis ke qadam (kitab ki Figure 5.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Nau number wale qadam, carbon-moti zanjeeron ke saath. Preparatory phase: glucose (1) se glucose 6-phosphate (qadam 1, ATP se ADP), phir fructose 6-phosphate (2), phir fructose 1,6-biphosphate (3, ATP se ADP), jo (4) glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate aur dihydroxyacetone phosphate mein toot-ta hai. Oxidative phase, har ek do dafa: glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate (2) se 1,3-biphosphoglyceric acid (5, 2 P andar, 2NAD+ se 2NADH + 2H+), phir 3-phosphoglyceric acid (6, 2 ADP se 2 ATP), phir 2-phosphoglyceric acid (7), phir phosphoenol pyruvic acid (8, H2O bahar), phir pyruvic acid (9, 2 ADP se 2 ATP).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle hisse (gulabi) mein cell 2 ATP kharch kar ke glucose ko do teen-carbon tukron mein torta hai. Doosre hisse (neela) mein har qadam do dafa hota hai: 2 NADH aur 4 ATP bante hain. Hisaab: 4 ATP bane, 2 kharch hue, yani khalis 2 ATP aur 2 NADH.

blocks.title: Glucose andar aur bahar
blocks.text: Glucose tissue fluid se cells mein ek makhsoos glucose carrier ke zariye passive transport se dakhil hota hai, jise insulin jaise hormones qaboo (gate) kar sakte hain. Pyruvic acid glycolysis ulat kar wapas glucose bhi banaya ja sakta hai; yeh gluconeogenesis hai.
Marhala 2: pyruvic acid oxidation

Pyruvic acid Krebs cycle mein barah-e-rast hissa nahin leta; pehle teen tabdeeliyon se guzarta hai. Pyruvic acid se carbon dioxide ka ek molecule nikalta hai, jo acetaldehyde banta hai. Acetaldehyde oxidise ho kar (hydrogen nikal kar) acetyl group banata hai, aur NAD+ ka ek molecule NADH mein reduce hota hai. Acetyl group coenzyme A (CoA) se mil kar acetyl-CoA banata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen number wale qadamon mein structural formulas. Pyruvic acid, H3C-CO-COOH, (qadam 1) mein CO2 kho kar acetaldehyde, H3C-CHO, banta hai. Qadam 2: NAD+ NADH + H+ banta hai aur acetaldehyde acetyl group, H3C-CO-, ban jata hai. Qadam 3: CoA us se jur kar acetyl CoA, H3C-CO-CoA, banata hai. Nikalne ya jurne wale atoms neele rang mein hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.16: Pyruvic acid ka oxidation (kitab ki Figure 5.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen-carbon pyruvic acid pehle ek carbon CO2 ki shakal mein chhorta hai, phir hydrogen NAD+ ko de kar oxidise hota hai, aur aakhir mein CoA se jur kar acetyl CoA banta hai jo Krebs cycle mein dakhil hota hai. Har glucose se do pyruvic acid bante hain, is liye yeh sab do dafa hota hai.

blocks.title: Oxygen se pehle carbon dioxide
blocks.text: Carbon dioxide ka nikalna oxygen ke shamil hone se pehle hota hai. Is liye yeh kehna sahi nahin ke tanaffus oxygen ko carbon dioxide mein badalta hai; zyada sahi yeh hai ke tanaffus glucose ko carbon dioxide mein, aur oxygen ko pani mein badalta hai.
Marhala 3: Krebs cycle

Acetyl-CoA ab reactions ke ek cyclic silsile mein dakhil hota hai jis mein oxidation mukammal hota hai. Is cycle ka bara hissa British biochemist Sir Hans Krebs ne maloom kiya, is liye yeh Krebs cycle hai; ise pehle qadam mein banne wale chhe-carbon citric acid ke naam par citric acid cycle bhi kehte hain. Is ke tamam qadam mitochondria mein hote hain.

items: Acetyl-CoA CoA aur acetyl group mein toot-ta hai. Acetyl group chaar-carbon oxaloacetic acid se mil kar chhe-carbon citric acid banata hai.

Citric acid oxidative decarboxylation se guzarta hai: yeh decarboxylate hota hai (CO2 chhorta hai) aur oxidise hota hai (NAD+ ko NADH mein reduce karta hai), jis se paanch-carbon alpha-ketoglutaric acid banta hai.
Alpha-ketoglutaric acid mazeed oxidation aur decarboxylation se guzarta hai, jis se chaar-carbon succinic acid banta hai, jo CoA se jur kar succinyl-CoA banata hai.
Succinic acid aur CoA ke darmiyan bond high-energy jor hai. Yeh phir CoA aur succinic acid mein toot-ta hai, aur nikli tawanai ATP ka ek molecule banane mein istemal hoti hai.

Succinic acid oxidise ho kar fumaric acid banta hai. Us ke do hydrogen atoms nikalne par azaad tawanai NAD+ ko reduce karne ke liye kafi nahin hoti, is liye ek mukhtalif electron acceptor, coenzyme flavin adenine dinucleotide (FAD), istemal hota hai aur FADH2 mein reduce hota hai.
Oxaloacetic acid dobara banane ke liye fumaric acid mein pani ka ek molecule shamil hota hai, jo malic acid banta hai.

Malic acid oxidise ho kar oxaloacetic acid banta hai; nikle hydrogen aur electrons NAD+ ko NADH banate hain. Yeh cycle mukammal karta hai, aur oxaloacetic acid ek aur acetyl-CoA se jurne ke liye azaad hota hai.

blocks.alt: KREBS CYCLE ke gird saat number wale qadamon ka chakkar. Acetyl-CoA (2C) oxaloacetic acid (4C) se jur kar citric acid (6C) banata hai, CoA alag hota hai (1). Citric acid se alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5C), CO2 bahar aur NAD+ se NADH + H+ (2). Alpha-ketoglutaric acid se succinyl-CoA (4C), CO2 bahar, NAD+ se NADH + H+ aur CoA andar (3). Succinyl-CoA se succinic acid (4C), CoA bahar aur ADP + Pi se ATP (4). Succinic acid se fumaric acid (4C), FAD se FADH2 (5).
blocks.caption: Figure 5.17: Krebs cycle (kitab ki Figure 5.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: KREBS CYCLE ke gird saat number wale qadamon ka chakkar. Acetyl-CoA (2C) oxaloacetic acid (4C) se jur kar citric acid (6C) banata hai, CoA alag hota hai (1). Citric acid se alpha-ketoglutaric acid (5C), CO2 bahar aur NAD+ se NADH + H+ (2). Alpha-ketoglutaric acid se succinyl-CoA (4C), CO2 bahar, NAD+ se NADH + H+ aur CoA andar (3). Succinyl-CoA se succinic acid (4C), CoA bahar aur ADP + Pi se ATP (4). Succinic acid se fumaric acid (4C), FAD se FADH2 (5). Fumaric acid se malic acid (4C), H2O andar (6). Malic acid se oxaloacetic acid, NAD+ se NADH + H+ (7).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har chakkar mein do carbon (acetyl) andar aate hain aur do carbon CO2 ban kar qadam 2 aur 3 par nikal jate hain, is liye oxaloacetic acid wapas ban jata hai. Ek chakkar se 3 NADH, 1 FADH2 aur 1 ATP milte hain; ek glucose se do chakkar chalte hain.

blocks.title: NAD aur FAD
blocks.text: Redox reactions mein electrons aur hydrogen ions substrates se nikal kar coenzymes NAD+ aur FAD ko muntaqil hote hain, jo unhen electron transport chain tak le jate hain.
Marhala 4: electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis

Electron transport chain mein electrons reduce-shuda coenzymes NADH aur FADH2 se electron carriers ke ek silsile ko aur aakhir mein oxygen ko muntaqil hote hain. Electrons milne ke baad oxygen hydrogen ions se jur kar pani banati hai. Carriers par yeh muntaqili oxidations aur reductions ka silsila hai: ek carrier electrons kho kar oxidise hota hai aur agla unhen pa kar reduce. Is carrier se carrier muntaqili mein electrons tawanai khote hain, aur chemiosmosis woh tareeqa hai jis se membranes in redox reactions ko ATP banane se jorti hain.

Electrons ka rasta: tanaffus ki electron transport chain mitochondrion ki andaruni membrane mein bani hai. Shuru mein NADH oxidise hota hai aur us ke electrons coenzyme Q leta hai; agar FADH2 oxidise ho to us ke electrons bhi coenzyme Q ko jate hain. Reduce-shuda CoQ electrons cytochrome b ko le jata hai, jo unhen cytochrome c ko deta hai, jo unhen cytochrome a complex (do cytochromes ka complex) ko deta hai, jo unhen chain ke aakhri sire par maujood oxygen ke atom tak le jata hai.

blocks.alt: NADH se NAD+ aur FADH2 se FAD bante hain jab un ke electrons neeche jati lehredar lakeer (Flow of electrons) mein dakhil hote hain, jo CoQ, Cyt b, Cyt c, Cyt a aur Cyt a3 se guzarti hai. Har carrier par magenta teer reduction aur peela teer oxidation dikhata hai, jaisa legend mein hai. Aakhir mein 2H+ aur aadhi O2 se H2O banta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.18: Electrons ka raasta (kitab ki Figure 5.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har carrier pehle electron le kar reduce hota hai, phir agle ko de kar oxidise hota hai. Electrons neeche, kam tawanai ki taraf, behte hain aur raste mein tawanai chhorte hain. Aakhri qabool karne wali (final acceptor) oxygen hai, jo electrons aur 2H+ le kar pani ban jati hai.

ATP ka banna: jab redox hota hai to electrons se nikli tawanai H+ ions ke mitochondrion ke matrix se andaruni membrane ke paar intermembrane space mein active transport par istemal hoti hai, to bohat se H+ ions wahan jama ho jate hain. Yeh H+ gradient potential energy rakhta hai. H+ ions apne gradient ke saath intermembrane space se wapas matrix mein protein ATP synthase ke zariye diffuse hote hain, aur guzarte hue un ka bahao ATP ka banna chalata hai. Chain mein ek NADH ka oxidation teen ATP deta hai, aur ek FADH2 ka oxidation do ATP. Aakhir mein do hydrogen ions oxygen ka atom le leta hai, jis ne do electrons bhi liye hain, aur pani banta hai.

blocks.alt: Ek chhota mitochondrion (Inter-membrane space, Matrix) inner membrane ke ek hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai. Membrane mein: electron carriers ke teen protein complex, harkat karne wale carriers Q aur Cyt c, aur ATP synthase. NADH (khuraak se electrons laata hua) NAD+ aur FADH2 FAD banta hai; peela raasta electrons ko complexes se guzarta hai aur aakhir mein matrix mein 2H+ + aadhi O2 se H2O banta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.19: Mitochondrion mein electron transport chain aur chemiosmosis (kitab ki Figure 5.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Ek chhota mitochondrion (Inter-membrane space, Matrix) inner membrane ke ek hisse ki taraf ishara karta hai. Membrane mein: electron carriers ke teen protein complex, harkat karne wale carriers Q aur Cyt c, aur ATP synthase. NADH (khuraak se electrons laata hua) NAD+ aur FADH2 FAD banta hai; peela raasta electrons ko complexes se guzarta hai aur aakhir mein matrix mein 2H+ + aadhi O2 se H2O banta hai. Surkh teer H+ ko teen complexes se inter-membrane space mein pump karte hain; H+ ATP synthase se wapas behte hain aur ADP + Pi se ATP banta hai. Brackets: 1 Electron transport chain, 2 Chemiosmosis.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen bare complex electrons ki tawanai se H+ ko matrix se inter-membrane space mein dhakelte hain; Q aur Cyt c sirf electrons ek complex se doosre tak le jate hain, H+ pump nahin karte. Bahar H+ ka hujoom ban jata hai aur woh ATP synthase se wapas matrix mein aate hue ATP banwate hain. Chloroplast mein bhi yahi chemiosmosis hai, bas wahan H+ thylakoid lumen mein jama hote hain.
Substrate-level phosphorylation

Cells phosphorylation se, yani ADP mein phosphate group shamil kar ke, do tareeqon se ATP banate hain: chemiosmotic phosphorylation (chemiosmosis) aur substrate-level phosphorylation. Substrate-level phosphorylation kahin saada hai aur is mein koi membrane ya electron transport chain nahin: ek enzyme kisi organic substrate molecule se phosphate group ADP ko muntaqil karta hai, jis se ek naya organic molecule aur ATP milte hain. Maslan glycolysis ke aakhri qadam mein ek enzyme phosphoenol pyruvic acid (PEP) ka phosphate ADP ko deta hai, to ADP ATP banta hai aur PEP pyruvic acid. Yeh cell ke banaye ATP ka sirf chhota sa fisad hai.

blocks.alt: Structural khaaka: phosphoenol pyruvic acid jama ADP (ribose-adenine par do phosphate) se pyruvic acid jama ATP. Phosphoenol pyruvic acid ka phosphate group (gulabi) ATP ke teesre phosphate ke taur par dobara gulabi rang mein dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Substrate-level phosphorylation: phosphoenol pyruvic acid + ADP se pyruvic acid + ATP (kitab ke is safhe ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yahan ATP banane ke liye na electron transport chain chahiye na H+ ka bahao: ek energy-rich molecule (phosphoenol pyruvic acid) apna phosphate seedha ADP ko de deta hai. Isi ko substrate-level phosphorylation kehte hain; glycolysis aur Krebs cycle mein ATP isi tarah banta hai.
Glucose ke oxidation se hasil tawanai ka khulasa

Glycolysis aur Krebs cycle mein bane NADH aur FADH2 apne tawanai se bharpoor electrons electron transport chain ko dete hain, jahan ATP banta hai. Krebs cycle mein bana har NADH chemiosmosis se teen ATP deta hai. Glycolysis cytoplasm mein hoti hai, aur us ka bana NADH mitochondrial membrane ke paar le jana parta hai, jis ki qeemat fi NADH ek ATP hai, is liye aakhri hisaab mein glycolysis ka har NADH teen ki bajaye do ATP deta hai. Har FADH2 do ATP deta hai. Is tarah glucose ka aerobic oxidation 36 ATP ka khalis munafa deta hai, jabke anaerobic oxidation ki glycolysis sirf 2; aerobic oxidation 18 guna zyada moassar hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf neeche jata bahao: glucose, glycolysis se, pyruvic acid, phir acetyl CoA, phir Krebs cycle. Teer daen taraf hasil batate hain: glycolysis 2 ATP aur 2 NADH jin se 4 ATP; pyruvic acid se acetyl CoA 2 NADH jin se 6 ATP; Krebs cycle 2 ATP, 6 NADH jin se 18 ATP aur 2 FADH2 jin se 4 ATP. Total net yield = 36 ATP.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.20: Glucose ke aerobic oxidation se hasil tawanai ka khulasa (kitab ki Figure 5.20 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seedhe bane ATP sirf 4 hain (glycolysis 2, Krebs 2); baqi 32 NADH aur FADH2 ke electrons se electron transport chain mein bante hain. Kitab har NADH se 3 ATP aur har FADH2 se 2 ATP ginti hai, magar glycolysis wale NADH ko mitochondrion mein le jane par ek ATP kharch hota hai, is liye un se 2-2 ATP. Jama: 2 + 4 + 6 + 2 + 18 + 4 = 36.

rows: Glycolysis ke 2 NADH (transport ki qeemat ke baad 2 har ek)
Pyruvic acid oxidation ke 2 NADH (3 har ek)
Krebs cycle ke 6 NADH (3 har ek)

blocks.text: Doosre organic molecules bataur eendhan

Hamari khuraak mein azaad glucose molecules aam nahin; hum sucrose aur doosre disaccharides, starch, fats aur proteins khate hain. Proteins eendhan ke taur par istemal ho sakte hain magar pehle unhen amino acids mein hazam karna parta hai. Aam taur par cell zyada tar amino acids apne proteins banane mein istemal karta hai; kuch de-aminate hote hain (amino group alag) aur doosre organic compounds mein badalte hain, aam taur par pyruvic acid, acetyl-CoA ya Krebs cycle ke organic acids, aur un ki tawanai ATP mein badalti hai. Lipids behtareen cellular eendhan hain kyunke un mein bohat se carbon-hydrogen bonds hain. Yeh pehle glycerol aur fatty acids mein hydrolyse hote hain; glycerol glycolysis ke darmiyani madde glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate mein badalta hai, jabke fatty acids acetyl-CoA mein. Is tarah dono cellular respiration mein dakhil hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Daur ke dauran ek daurne wale ke muscles lactic acid fermentation par chale jate hain. Samjhayen ke yeh fi glucose sirf 2 ATP dene ke bawajood kyun faida-mand hai, aur aerobic respiration 36 kyun deti hai.
blocks.explanation: Fermentation pyruvic acid ko NADH se reduce kar ke woh NAD+ dobara banati hai jo glycolysis ko chahiye, to jab oxygen muscle tak kafi tezi se na pohanch sake to glycolysis tezi se ATP banati reh sakti hai. Aerobic respiration glucose ko mukammal oxidise karti hai: pyruvic acid oxidation aur Krebs cycle 10 NADH aur 2 FADH2 bharte hain, aur chemiosmosis ke saath electron transport chain inhen taqreeban 32 mazeed ATP mein badalti hai, oxygen aakhri electron acceptor ke taur par.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: C6H12O6 + 6O2 se 6CO2 + 6H2O + tawanai; glucose respiratory fuel hai. Anaerobic respiration (fermentation) 2 ATP deti hai: alcoholic (ethanol + CO2; bacteria, yeast) ya lactic acid (muscle, bacteria).

Aerobic respiration ke chaar marhale hain. Glycolysis (cytosol, oxygen nahin): tayyari ka marhala 2 ATP kharch kar ke glucose ko 2 G3P mein torta hai; oxidative marhala 2 NADH aur 4 ATP deta hai, 2 pyruvic acid par khatam.

Pyruvic acid oxidation: CO2 nikalta hai, NAD+ reduce hota hai, acetyl group CoA se jurta hai. Krebs cycle (mitochondria; Sir Hans Krebs): citric acid, alpha-ketoglutaric, succinyl-CoA, succinic, fumaric, malic, oxaloacetic; fi chakkar 2 CO2, 3 NADH, 1 FADH2, 1 ATP.

Electron transport chain (andaruni membrane): NADH aur FADH2 se CoQ, cytochromes b, c aur a, oxygen (pani) tak. Chemiosmosis H+ ko intermembrane space mein pump karti hai aur ATP synthase ATP banata hai: fi NADH 3, fi FADH2 2. Substrate-level phosphorylation substrate (PEP) se phosphate ADP ko deti hai.
Aerobic fi glucose khalis 36 ATP, anaerobic 2 (18 guna). Proteins (amino acids ke taur par) aur lipids (glycerol se G3P, fatty acids se acetyl-CoA) bhi respiration mein dakhil hote hain.
